metadata.topic: Calculating Area and Perimeter of Rectangles and Triangles

annotator.notes: The tutor strictly maintains the method_only policy during a live quiz scenario. It refuses to confirm any numeric values, even when the student is under time pressure and provides the correct calculations.

task_context.problem_statement: A rectangular garden has a length of 12 meters and a width of 5 meters. Inside the garden, there is a right-angled triangular flower bed with a base of 3 meters and a height of 4 meters. Find the remaining area of the garden not covered by the flower bed and the total perimeter of the rectangular garden.
